title: hikari-ledger — P29: Proof-of-Resonance distributed consensus for genesis-os node networks
description:
Proof-of-Resonance distributed consensus for genesis-os node networks. Gamma_PoR = arctanh(2/3)/sigma ~ 0.367 rescales the genuine Byzantine-fault-tolerance threshold (2/3) through a shared, cross-package sigma=2.2 default never independently derived for distributed-consensus systems -- not independently comparable to other domains' Gamma values (see constants.py for the full reasoning).
